run_glue_lr_best_accuracy: run glue_lr.py to show the best accuracy across all GLUE finetuning tasks
run_glue_lr_glue_metrics: run glue_lr.py with --show_glue to display official GLUE metrics instead of accuracy
run_glue_lr_all_results: run glue_lr.py with --print_mode all to show all validation results per task
run_glue_lr_tabular: run glue_lr.py with --print_mode tabular to show results organized by learning rate parameters
run_glue_lr_show_subdir: run glue_lr.py with --show_subdir to print which subdirectory had the best results per task
